build_fcos_model: build an FCOS object detection model with ResNet50 backbone and FPN neck for V3Det dataset
configure_training_loop: configure an iteration-based training loop with AdamW optimizer and linear warmup learning rate schedule
setup_data_preprocessor: setup a detection data preprocessor with ImageNet normalization and 32-pixel padding divisor
define_loss_functions: define focal custom loss for classification, IoU loss for bounding boxes, and centerness loss
configure_inference_pipeline: configure inference with NMS threshold 0.6, score threshold 0.0001, and max 300 detections per image
